alternative_interpretations: The blur is merely photographic artifact from normal walking speed, not symbolic of time.

symbolic_mapping: proximity without interaction implies mediated coexistence
philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: Physical proximity without direct engagement illustrates a modern condition of social existence defined by simultaneous autonomy and constraint—individual work zones within a common environment enforce both freedom and implicit norms.
alternative_interpretations: People may be temporarily occupied and will interact shortly; spatial arrangement reflects practical ergonomics, not ideology.
limitations: No eye contact, conversation, or gesture data confirms relational dynamics; layout could be purely functional.
